## What's new

Threadnote 5.3.0-beta.3 keeps preview and confirmation visible beside memory conflict choices and lets shared “Both memories apply” reviews save locally.

### Keep conflict actions visible

The memory comparison keeps Preview and Confirm together in a persistent footer as you choose how to resolve the conflict.

### Save a local decision for shared memories

Confirming “Both memories apply” for shared memories saves a local decision for the reviewed versions. It does not edit or publish either source, and a source change brings the conflict back for review. Editing or archiving a shared source still requires its owner's review.
